countyDirectory.name: DDAP County Drug and Alcohol Offices (Single County Authorities)

narrNote: PARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22); PARR's own site was fetched and content-checked this run (Philadelphia-based, statewide).
notes: DDAP is Pennsylvania's Single State Agency for substance use services (per SAMHSA's SSA directory, confirmed via NASADAD's SSA listing and on pa.gov). Pennsylvania's real county layer is the Single County Authorities (SCAs): the countyDirectory entry is DDAP's official County Drug and Alcohol Offices page — the fetched page confirms the SCAs administer local treatment access, funding, and referrals (individual office listings load through the page's search widget). agency.phone is null: DDAP's published statewide number is its Get Help Now helpline (listed under stateCrisis), and a main-office number could not be confirmed on a fetched pa.gov page this run. The Get Help Now helpline (1-800-662-HELP) is free, confidential, 24/7/365, by call, text (717-216-0905), or live chat, per DDAP's official campaign page, fetched this run. Medicaid: Pennsylvania Medicaid (Medical Assistance) covers mental health and drug and alcohol services through the Behavioral HealthChoices program; the medicaidSud URL is the PA Department of Human Services Behavioral Health page, whose 'Medicaid - Mental Health / Drug and Alcohol Services' section was verified on the fetched page. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
